skill_name: Recommend a book that best explains aging.
workflow: The Longevity Paradox: How to Die Young at a Very Old Age by Steven R. Gundry, M.D. is a comprehensive and engaging guide to aging gracefully and healthily. From explaining the latest scientific discoveries about longevity to debunking the myths about aging, Dr. Gundry goes beyond just physical health to the emotional side of aging with practical advice on how to adapt to this stage of life. The book also provides an array of nutrition, lifestyle, and supplement recommendations for slowing down
